description: emulateapj (CTAN, 2025/02/19; MiKTeX package emulateapj), the ApJ two-column look built on REVTeX, two columns by default. The revtex4 option makes it load REVTeX 4.0 straight away. That is MiKTeX's revtex4 package, v4.0a 2020/09/30, which is patched for the 2020-10 kernel. MiKTeX has no revtex4-1, so the class's \IfFileExists{revtex4-1.cls} would fall back to the same file anyway. The preamble is empty: \journalinfo, \submitted and the running heads have defaults, and an author with no \affiliation only gives a warning.
